liveModelDry.note: Three runs of live model children on the dry gateway; the local validator would not boot in that window. 49 of 150 decisions (32.7%) had no usable reply and fell back to the scripted policy of the same name. Zero chain refusals: no agent asked above the ceiling, so these runs did not test the ceiling.

liveModelDrySecondBatch.note: Twelve runs, 19 datasets, final summary reports/swarm-llm-dry/SUMMARY.md. Dry gateway: nothing was sent to any chain, so the 11 refusals coded 6010 are predictions, every one from a scripted fallback and none from a model.

scriptedSecondBatch.note: Scripted policies, no model spend. The source totals mix 4 dry and 4 validator runs and do not split the 10 refusals by kind; read them as dry-or-validator unsplit, not as 10 validator refusals.

disclaimer: Synthetic data only. None of it measures a real market.
